X-16 Authorization layer 4: program scope

Bangla name: অথরাইজেশন স্তর ৪: প্রোগ্রাম স্কোপ

← 60 · Cross-cutting · Contents · Open queries

1. Name and purpose

Program scope. Staff other than admin should work only on the programs (series/tournaments) assigned to them in custom:program_ids. The code has two separate mechanisms that use the X-Program-Id header:

  1. a data filter: an EF Core global query filter in the Admin service that limits program-owned rows to the program in the header;
  2. an access check: [AuthorizeProgram], which compares the header with the user's program_id claims, used only on the dashboard.

2. Trigger and actor

Item Value
Actor Admin-portal users after choosing a program (A-01)
Client Admin portal ProgramIdInterceptor sends X-Program-Id on every request (X-04)
Service Admin only

3. Business flow

A staff member picks a program; from then on lists (events, promo codes, discounts, notices, ticket layouts, …) show only that program's data. Choosing "back to global menu" sets the program to 0, which shows the global menu (X-17).

4. Technical flow

# Step Detail
1 ProgramIdMiddleware Parses X-Program-Id; stores it in HttpContext.Items["ProgramId"] (0 when missing, not a number, or ≤ 0)
2 ProgramIdAccessor Scoped service that reads Items["ProgramId"]
3 AdminDbContext query filter For every entity implementing IHasProgramId: ProgramId <= 0 OR entity.ProgramId == ProgramId
4 [AuthorizeProgram] (dashboard only) Role admin → pass. Role user → pass ("portal user … not defined yet"). Otherwise: header missing/invalid/negative → 400 "Missing or invalid X-Program-Id header."; header not in the user's program_id claims → 403 "User does not have permission for program with Id {id}."

Entities filtered (IHasProgramId): Event, EventVenueDetails, ProgramTeam, ProgramVenue, ProgramVenueDetails, ProgramSettings, PromoCode, PromoCodeAssign, Discount, DiscountAssign, GeneralNotice, TicketCheckerGate, TicketAttributes, TicketLayoutConfig, UserIssue, UserIssueChatMessage.

5. Components

Kind Component
Client Admin portal ProgramService (localStorage.globalProgramId), ProgramIdInterceptor
Service Admin: ProgramIdMiddleware, ProgramIdAccessor, AdminDbContext, AuthorizeProgramAttribute, DashboardController
Claims program_id from custom:program_ids (X-15)

Header Values Effect

// 403 from [AuthorizeProgram] (plain text body, not ProblemDetails)

7. Data and side effects

None; the filter only narrows queries.

9. Handover notes

  1. The data filter is not an access control. It trusts the header. A user limited to program 1 who sends X-Program-Id: 2 sees program 2's rows; sending 0 (or no header) removes the filter entirely. Only the dashboard checks the header against the user's programs.
  2. The 403 branch does not stop the action. AuthorizeProgramAttribute writes the 403 response but does not set context.Result; for an IAsyncAuthorizationFilter MVC then continues and runs the action, which fails when it tries to write to a response that has already started. For the dashboard (read-only) the effect is an error log, but do not reuse the attribute for write endpoints as it is.
  3. Only the Admin service has the middleware and filter. Booking, Ticketing and UserIssue receive the header and ignore it; their admin endpoints take programId as a query parameter instead (e.g. reports, A-22).
  4. user role passes [AuthorizeProgram], but the dashboard's class attribute requires admin or ticket_operator with the Admin pool, so customers cannot reach it.
